content: Jesús, ome-Samariaʼgined-ebo sunmaksad
Dummad-Jesús wisguargu, Fariseoʼmar weyob dulemar-sunmake itoye: Jesús, diigi-dule-oged-Juanʼba bur bule dulemar-Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged imakdiiye, degi, bur bule sapingan nikbarye.
(Ar Jesúsʼdi Bab-Dummad-diigi-ogleged-igar imakdisulindo, e-sapingan imakdiinad).
A-ular, Jesús Judea-yargi bangudsunnad, gannar Galilea-yarse nadegusad.
Galileaʼse naegala, Samaria-yargi naergebed.
Jesús, Samaria-yalase, Sicar-neggweburse nonisunnad. Bia dad-Jacob e-machi-Joséʼga nainu-uksad-walik, ase nonisunnad.
Agine Jacob-dia-akwisad siid. Jesús nanasadba yegussoggu, obunnogega a-dia-dikarba sigisad. Deun, bato yorukugusad.
Ome-wargwen, Samariaʼgined, dii-suega a-diase nonikid. Jesús a-omega sogded: —Anga be dii wis-udage.
Ar ade, Jesús-sapingan neggweburse mas-bakega naded.
Judíoʼmar, degi, Samaria-dorgan na ebo geg sunmakmarsoggu, ome-Samariaʼgined, Jesús-abin sogded: —Ar be, Judío-duled. Andi Samariaʼginedid, ar ¿ibiga be anse dii egise?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —Ar Bab-Dummad-ibmar-uked be wisina, degine, doa-dule bega soge: ‘Anga dii gobega be udaye,’ ese be dii egisoenad, degine, e bega dii-burba-nikad ukoenad.
Ome, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, ar be dii-weed sated, deginbali, dia matusurbalid, degite, ¿bia be dii-burba-nikadi onogosunna?
¿Ar be anmar-dad-Jacobʼba bur dummadsi? Anmar-dad we-dia anmarga uksad. We-dii na gobsad, degi, e-mimmigan, e-molimar, we-dii gobsamarmogad.
Jesús, ome-abin sogded: —Ar doa-dule we-dii-gobsale, gannar uku-uku itobaloed.
Ar dii-an-ega-ukoed gobsardi, bar gannar uku-uku itogosulid. Ar dii-an-ega-ukoeddi, dii napa-urba-aryomaiyobi, burba-geg-bergued e-ulubgi nikuoed.
Ome, Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, melle an bar gannar uku-uku itogega, we-dii be anga udage. Adi, an melle wese gannar bar dii wedagegar.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be nae. Be-suise be gornae, degi, gannar be dagbalo.
Ome, abin-sogded: —An, sui sated. Jesús, abin-imakded: —Nabir be soged: ‘An, sui sateye.’
Ar be walatargus sui ogwadanikid. Emi sui-be-nikadi be-suisurbalid. Ar nabir be-sogsad.
Ome, Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, an be-dakgua, be Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged an be-dakdo.
Anmar-dadgan-Samaria-dulemar, we-yargi Bab-Dummad-nug odummosmalad. Ar bemar-Judíoʼmardi soged, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega Jerusalénʼgi, Bab-Dummadse golergebye.
Jesús omega sogded: —Omegwa, napira an bega soged, mer be an-bengu. Ibagan dani, be Babse-golega, be Bab-nug-odummogega, be we-yarse danikosulid, degine, be Jerusalénʼse naosurbalid.
Bemar Samaria-dulemar be wissurmalad, doa-e-nug bemar odummonanai. Anmar-Judíoʼmardi wismalad, ar doa-e-nug anmar odummomala. Ar ade, dulemar-abonoleged Judíoʼmargi danikid.
Ar ibagan dani, emigindi, bato nonikid, ar dulemar-Bab-Dummad-nug-odummomalad, nue-burbar, degi, napiragwadgi Bab-Dummad-nug odummomaloed. Ar Bab-Dummad dulemar-degi-ese-goled amidimogad.
Bab-Dummad, burbaled. Ar dule-Bab-Dummadse-goledi, burbar, degi, napiragwadgi ese gormogargebed.
Ome, Jesúsʼga sogded: —An wisi, Mesías nonikoed. (Mesías sogleged, yoedse-Dule-Wargwen-Barmiledagoye-soglesad). We Cristoʼye soglebalid. A-Cristo nonikile, bela anmarga ibmar sognonikoed.
Jesús, ome-abin sogded: —Ani an a-duled, bebo-sunmaksiid.
Jesús-e-sapingan gannar Jesúsʼbo ambikusmalad
Agi e-sapingan nonikid, amar Jesús ome-ebo-sunmaksiid, geger dakdemalad. Degi-inigwele, gwen ega sogsasurmalad: “¿Ibu omese be egichii? ¿Ibigi ome-bebo be sunmaksii?”
Degi, ome e-gwidu-mete neggweburse nadsunnad. Neggweburse modapgu, macherganga sogdapid:
—Be dagmar, dule-wargwen bela an-ibmar-imaksad-anga-sogsad, be dakdamar, ¿abakalegi we-dule Cristoʼsua?
Degi, dulemar neggweburgi ainiarmargu, bela Jesúsʼse nonimalad.
Degi-gunaigua, e-sapingan Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusmalad, ega sognai guarmalad: —Odurdaked-saila, wis mas be gungwele.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Andi masgunned an nikad, a-masgunned bemar wissurmalad.
Degi, e-sapingan muchub-muchub sokarmalad: “Ar dule-wargwen masgunned ega senonisua.”
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Dule-an-barmialidba an ibmar-imaked, degi, an e-arbaed-obeloged, an-masgunnedid.

Ar bemarde sogsursi: Ibmar-gwag-weed-iba, amba nii-walabake napye. Andi an bemarga sogdo, nue be atakmar, nainu be dakmar. Ibmar-gwag welegega bato guagwar naid. Deyobi, dulemar abonolegega, guagwar bukwad.

”Ar dule-abonolegedgi-arbaedi bennukleged. Degi, burba-geg-berguedga arbabalid. Degisoggu, dule-abonolegega, dule-gebe-Bab-gayaburba-odurdakedi, degi, dulemar-Babgadga-guega-imaked-ebo, na wergumalad.
”Ar we-ibmar-sogleged nue-napira sogleged: ‘Dule-gwensak ibmar-gwag-digedid, dule-baiddi, ibmar-gwag-weedid.’
Bemar ibmar-gwaggi-arbassurmalad-weega an bemar-barminanaid. Dule-baigan arbasmalad, bemar a-arbasadgi dogdemalad.”
Samaria-dorgan Jesúsʼgi bengussurmalad
Bukidar Samaria-dorgan, Sicar-neggweburginmalad Jesús-bengussurmalad, ar ade, ome Jesúsʼgi sogdiid: “Bela an-ibmar-imaksad anga sogsaye.”
Degine, bukidar Jesúsʼse Samaria-dorgan duurmaknonimalad, egi wilenaigusmalad: “Anmar-walik be beeye.” Jesús amar-walik ibabo dulemar-odurdakega megissunnad.
Ome-ibmar-sogsadba, bur bule bukidar dulemar Jesús-ibmar-sogsadgi bengussurmalad.

A-ulale, omega sokarmalad: —Anmar-Jesúsʼgi-bensulidi unnila be anmarga ibmar sogedginsulid. Ar anmar-sunnad itosmarmogad. Anmar nue-wisid, we-dule napneggi dule-isgubukmalad-abonoged-sunnadid. We-dule, Bab-Dummad-Dule-Wargwen-Barmiledagoye sogsad-duled.
Jesús dule-dummad-e-machi-uellemaid nudaksad
Jesús, Sicar-neggweburgi ibabo megisad-sorbali, Galileaʼse naega Samaria-yargi nodegusad.
Ar Jesús na e-sunnad sogsa gusmogad, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedi e-neggweburgi geg e-nug odummoleye.
Jesús Galileaʼse nonigu, Galilea-dorgan nuedgi abindaksamalad, ar ade, ibase arbimarmosoggu, agi daksamalad, igi Jesús Jerusalénʼgi ibmar imaksa.
Degisoggu, Jesús gannar Galilea-yarse nonigu, Caná-neggweburse, bia dii vinoʼga obinnisadse, nadegusad. Deun, Capernaúm-neggweburgi dule-dummad-reyga-arbaed-e-machi uellemaid.
We-dule itoargu, Jesús, Judea-yarba-gudiid Galilea-yarse noniye, Jesúsʼse nadegusad. Jesúsʼgi wilenaigualid, adi, e-machi ega nudaknaegar. Ar ade, e-machi burgwedani maid.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisurmalad, degi, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad bemar daksasulina, be an-benmalanad.
Dule-dummad-reyga-arbaed, sogded: —Dummad, an-machi-burgwed-idu gwae be anba dage.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Be nae, be-machi dula gudiid. Reyga-arbaed Jesús-degi-ega-sogsad gwen bengussulid. Degisoggu, e-negse nadegusad.
Negse monadapgu, e-maigan abin-noarmalad. E-dummad-abingusmargu, ega sogdemalad: —Be-machi bato nugusad.
Degi, dummad e-maiganse egichialid igi-wachigi e-machi nuguar gusye. Abin-sogdemalad: —Sae, wachi-irgwengi uelleged gichaye.
Machigwa-e-bab mag itosad, a-wachigi Jesús ega sogsa gusad, be-machi dula gudiiye. Machigwa-e-bab, degine, bela e-negginmalad, Jesúsʼgi bensuli gunonimarsunnad.
Jesús Judea-yargi-gudiid Galilea-yarse nonigu, we-ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid ilabogus Galileaʼgi imaknonido.
